column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/dap/configs.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in configs.rs; the others
# move to src/dap/configs/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target dap_configs --check` after adding an item to configs.rs.
# configs.rs keeps DebugConfig, its RequestKind and its preLaunchTask.
